# 1. Model: Semantic Modeling Taxonomy v2
# 2. Description: Describes concepts related to Semantic Modeling placed in a Taxonomy view. Concepts, Relations, Descriptions, Explanations are generated by AI.  - v2 (05-04-2026): Updated for better consistency

# 3. === MODEL GUIDANCE ===
# 4. Use EXACT matching for names and IDs when updating existing elements.
# 5. Use '-' as a placeholder for fields that are not applicable to a specific type.
# 6. Use pipe (|) as column separator.
# 7. Do not change the header comments (lines starting with #).
# 8. TYPE GUIDE:
# 9. Term (term): A concept, entity, or element in the domain
# 10. Concept (concept): An abstract idea or notion
# 11. Property (property): An attribute or characteristic of a term
# 12. Group (group): A visual container for grouping related terms
# 13. Label (label): A text label used for annotation
# 14. Connection Point (conpoint): A junction point for complex relations
